paper.title: Algorithm 874: BACOLR, spatial and temporal error control software for PDEs based on high order adaptive collocation
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 34(3) (TOMS 874, May 2008), Article 15
paper.note: DOI not verified in this wake; the article itself was not read (ACM Digital Library), so the claim rests on the shipped reference output.

code.archive: sha256 92131b07424008c41ecac9dd667412c84dd604e79cf8d58841df03db26acc58b (netlib.org/toms/874.zip as fetched 2026-11-26, HTTP 200; members include Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res1, driver1.f, res2, driver2.f, Src/src.f, Src/blas.f)
code.note: Fortran 77 under Fortran/Dp. driver1.f is a driver for the single-PDE problem (NPDE=1, KCOL=2, NINTMX=2000). Its printed output is shipped as Drivers/res1 (five output blocks, TOUT = 0.2 to 1.0 in steps of 0.2 with varying NINT, plus EXACTU columns). Unzip with python3 -I zipfile, then compile Src/src.f, Src/blas.f and driver1.f together.

field: numerics (method of lines, adaptive collocation for time-dependent PDEs)

claim.location: The shipped reference output of driver1.f, file Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res1 in 874.zip, the output block for TOUT = 1.0E+00 (KCOL = 2, NINT = 42; res1 line 854 is its header, line 1046 the value): at XOUT = 0.9100E+00 the printed UOUT is 0.6602E+00 (EXACTU column in the same line is also 0.6602E+00).
claim.metric: UOUT(1) at XOUT = 0.91 printed by driver1.f at TOUT = 1.0, the numerical solution of the single PDE (the printed value is the solver output, not the closed form).
claim.paper_value: Not used: the TOMS article was not read in this wake; the value is taken from the shipped driver output.

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The shipped output prints four significant digits (E18.4), so its own rounding is up to 5e-5. The driver requests ATOL = RTOL = 1e-6, so the solver's error target is far below the printed digits. 1e-3 absorbs print rounding and compiler and BLAS differences while staying well below the solution's variation near the front (about 0.5 per 0.01 in x at this point). Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 5 minutes: one Fortran compile of src.f (about 300 kB), blas.f and driver1.f, and one run of the driver.
cost.data_size: None (the problem and exact solution are in driver1.f).
cost.data_licence: Netlib TOMS code under the ACM licence; the rerun should record the licence text.

why: A deterministic PDE code whose shipped driver prints a solution value at a point on a steep front at a late output time; reproducing it exercises the adaptive collocation error control, not just a closed form.
